query: UPDATE invoice_deliveries SET status=$3,request=NULL,finished_at=CASE WHEN $3='unknown' THEN NULL ELSE now() END,pdf_file_id=coalesce(pdf_file_id,(SELECT i.pdf_file_id FROM invoices i WHERE i.workspace_id=$1 AND i.id=invoice_deliveries.invoice_id)) WHERE workspace_id=$1 AND id=$2 AND status IN ('running','sending','unknown') RETURNING action_id
